# ankra_registry_robots (Data Source)

Lists every registry robot the organisation holds: its members' own and the ones Ankra manages. Secrets are never listed. The counterpart of `ankra registry robots list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_registry_robots" "all" {}

output "expiring_robots" {
  value = [for robot in data.ankra_registry_robots.all.robots : robot.name if robot.expires_at != null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `robots` (Attributes List) Registry robots. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--robots))

<a id="nestedatt--robots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `robots`

Read-Only:

- `credential_name` (String) Organisation credential holding the robot's login.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `expires_at` (String) When the robot expires; null if never.
- `host` (String) Registry host.
- `kind` (String) `user`, `organisation` or `application`.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether Ankra mints and rotates the robot itself.
- `name` (String) Robot name.
- `permissions` (List of String) Grants, written `resource:action`.
- `project` (String) Registry project the robot is bound to.
- `registry` (String) Integrated registry entry; null on the Ankra registry.
- `robot_name` (String) The robot's user name on the registry.
- `scope` (String) `push`, `pull`, or `custom`.
